consequence.statement: External secret stores are removed; if you use them, you must migrate to native Kubernetes secrets or External Secrets Operator before upgrading.
consequence.remediation: Migrate to native Kubernetes secrets or External Secrets Operator before upgrading.

original.statement: The alpha, unmaintained external secret stores feature is removed in Crossplane v2; users must migrate to native Kubernetes secrets or External Secrets Operator before upgrading.

decision.reason: [ev-0c1262a1a2a5] lists external secret stores under "Removed features" in the v2 upgrade guide. It tells users of the feature to "migrate to native Kubernetes secrets or External Secrets Operator before upgrading", which is a required operator step before the upgrade. So migration-required (action required) matches the evidence, and the statement and remediation repeat its wording without claiming anything more.
